name: _flag.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app/_flag.scss — the nav language flag: the lang open button, the
//  flag wrapper's WebGL-canvas vs SVG-img fallback swap, and the
//  side-by-side split-flag variant (two country codes, edge radii).
//  Imported by app.scss (manifest) — uses $_B_NAV defined there.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

$_B_FLAG: 'flag';

// ── Nav flag images & WebGL Canvas ────────────────────────────────────────────
.#{$_B_NAV}-lang-open-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    transform: scale(1.15);
  }
}

.#{$_B_NAV}-flag-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  &:has(.#{$_B_FLAG}-canvas:not(.is-fallback):not([style*='display: none'])) {
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-img,
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-split {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  // Show SVG images when WebGL canvas has fallback
  &:has(.#{$_B_FLAG}-canvas.is-fallback) {
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-img,
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-split {
      display: block;
    }
  }

  .#{$_B_FLAG}-canvas {
    height: var(--space-lg);
    width: auto;
    display: block;
    border-radius: var(--space-2xs);
  }
}

.#{$_B_FLAG}-img {
  height: var(--space-lg);
  width: auto;
  max-height: var(--space-lg);
  display: block;
  border-radius: var(--space-2xs);
}

// Split flag: two country codes side by side
.#{$_B_FLAG}-split {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;

  .#{$_B_FLAG}-img {
    height: var(--space-lg);
    width: var(--space-md);
    max-height: var(--space-lg);
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 0;

    &:first-child {
      border-radius: var(--space-2xs) 0 0 var(--space-2xs);
      object-position: left center;
    }

    &:last-child {
      border-radius: 0 var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs) 0;
      object-position: right center;
    }
  }
}
